title: Keeping Harvey Weinstein’s Secrets, Part 2: Gloria Allred

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举办的DealBook峰会上，现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，您可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、未经修饰的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过nytimes.com网站，

sentences.en: November 18th.
sentences.zh: 对部分采访进行免费直播，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Previously on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 回顾《每日新闻》往期内容。

sentences.en: So there we are, moments from publishing the story, and the role of Lisa Bloom is finally coming into focus.
sentences.zh: 就在我们即将发布报道的前一刻，丽莎·布鲁姆的角色终于变得清晰起来。

sentences.en: Within a week, we'd realize that her mother had also played a surprising role.
sentences.zh: 一周之内，我们意识到她的母亲也扮演了一个令人惊讶的角色。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: So, we publish the story.
sentences.zh: 于是，我们发布了这篇报道。

sentences.en: Famed Hollywood producer Harvey Weinstein is responding tonight after the New York Times revealed decades of sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》揭露了哈维·韦恩斯坦数十年的性骚扰行为后，这位好莱坞著名制片人今晚做出了回应。

sentences.en: And the reaction starts to build.
sentences.zh: 随后，舆论开始发酵。

sentences.en: The idea that this predator, this assaulter, was out there silencing women, it's beyond infuriating.
sentences.zh: 想到这个掠夺者、这个施暴者竟然一直在压制女性，这简直令人愤怒至极。

sentences.en: Most of it is about Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 大部分舆论是针对哈维·韦恩斯坦的。

sentences.en: Some of it is about Lisa Bloom.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分则是针对丽莎·布鲁姆的。

sentences.en: Interestingly enough, one of the attorneys working with Weinstein is Lisa Bloom, daughter of the very high-profile women's rights attorney Gloria Allred.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，与韦恩斯坦合作的律师之一正是丽莎·布鲁姆，而她还是知名女权律师格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德的女儿。

sentences.en: People are incredulous that a women's rights advocate could have played this role.
sentences.zh: 人们难以置信，一位女权倡导者竟然会扮演这样的角色。

sentences.en: Celebrity lawyer Lisa Bloom sells herself as a fiery champion of the oppressed.
sentences.zh: 明星律师丽莎·布鲁姆一直标榜自己是受压迫者的坚定捍卫者。

sentences.en: She represented one of Bill Cosby's accusers and three women who said Bill O'Reilly sexually harassed them.
sentences.zh: 她曾代理过比尔·科斯比的一名指控者，以及三名声称受到比尔·奥莱利性骚扰的女性。

sentences.en: Yet in the case of Harvey Weinstein,
sentences.zh: 然而在哈维·韦恩斯坦的案件中，

sentences.en: Lisa Bloom took the side of the predator over the prey.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·布鲁姆却站在了掠夺者一边，而非受害者一方。

sentences.en: She's normally on the other side.
sentences.zh: 她通常是站在对立面的。

sentences.en: She's normally the first attorney defending women in most of these cases.
sentences.zh: 在大多数此类案件中，她通常是第一位为女性辩护的律师。

sentences.en: Which may have something to do with why you hired her.
sentences.zh: 这或许就是你雇佣她的原因所在。

sentences.en: Well, it'll be interesting to see how this whole thing plays out.
sentences.zh: 好吧，看看这件事最终会如何收场将会很有趣。

sentences.en: So then...
sentences.zh: 那么……

sentences.en: Joining me now is attorney Gloria Allred, whose daughter, attorney Lisa Bloom, is on Harvey Weinstein's legal team.
sentences.zh: 现在加入我的是律师格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德，她的女儿丽莎·布鲁姆律师目前在哈维·韦恩斯坦的法律团队中。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for coming in.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您能来到节目现场。

sentences.en: Gloria Allred starts to play a public role in this story.
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德开始在这个故事中扮演公开角色。

sentences.en: I don't second-guess her choices.
sentences.zh: 我不会去质疑她的选择。

sentences.en: I don't criticize her choices.
sentences.zh: 我并没有批评她的选择。

sentences.en: But it's kind of a strange and a confusing one.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是一个有点奇怪且令人困惑的选择。

sentences.en: What is that dynamic right now?
sentences.zh: 现在这是一种什么样的关系动态？

sentences.en: Well, my daughter has her own law firm.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我女儿有她自己的律师事务所。

sentences.en: She is not with my law firm.
sentences.zh: 她不在我的律所工作。

sentences.en: She is an independent attorney.
sentences.zh: 她是一位独立执业律师。

sentences.en: On the one hand, she sounds kind of disapproving of her daughter.
sentences.zh: 一方面，她听起来对自己的女儿有些不赞同。

sentences.en: I mean, I've been a lawyer for almost 42 years.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我当律师已经快42年了。

sentences.en: We're the leading women's rights law firm in the nation, and we represent victims of sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 我们是全国领先的女性权益律师事务所，我们代理性骚扰受害者的案件。

sentences.en: We don't represent persons accused of sexually harassing.
sentences.zh: 我们不代理被控性骚扰的人。

sentences.en: She's saying that she, Gloria Allred, only represents accusers so that she would never represent the accused.
sentences.zh: 她是在说她自己，格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德，只代理指控者，所以她绝不会代理被指控者。

sentences.en: On the other hand...
sentences.zh: 另一方面……

sentences.en: That is not a statement of criticism of my daughter.
sentences.zh: 那并不是在批评我的女儿。

sentences.en: She's kind of defending her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她是在为她女儿辩护。

sentences.en: She's an outstanding attorney, and all I can say is Harvey Weinstein is very fortunate to have her.
sentences.zh: 她是一位杰出的律师，我只能说哈维·韦恩斯坦能有她代理真是太幸运了。

sentences.en: But mostly what she's conveying...
sentences.zh: 但她主要传达的是……

sentences.en: Mr. Weinstein can exercise any legal rights, but that doesn't take care of the people I care about.
sentences.zh: 韦恩斯坦先生可以行使任何法律权利，但这并不能解决我所关心的人的问题。

sentences.en: ...is that she, Gloria Allred...
sentences.zh: ……那就是她，格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德……

sentences.en: Numerous alleged victims of Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 哈维·韦恩斯坦的众多所谓受害者。

sentences.en: We want justice for them.
sentences.zh: 我们要为她们伸张正义。

sentences.en: ...is open for business.
sentences.zh: ……正在营业中。

sentences.en: Meaning what exactly?
sentences.zh: 具体是什么意思？

sentences.en: So as you remember from this time...
sentences.zh: 正如你们记得的那样……

sentences.en: Two more women have come forward accusing media mogul Harvey Weinstein...
sentences.zh: 又有两名女性站出来指控媒体大亨哈维·温斯坦……

sentences.en: Two more women coming forward and making serious allegations...
sentences.zh: 又有两名女性站出来，提出了严重的指控……

sentences.en: There is a flood of Harvey Weinstein victims coming forward.
sentences.zh: 哈维·温斯坦的受害者正纷纷站出来。

sentences.en: In graphic detail, accusing Harvey Weinstein and adding to the list that has now grown to more than 60.
sentences.zh: 她们详细地描述了细节，指控哈维·温斯坦，使得名单上的人数现在已经增加到了60多人。

sentences.en: Gloria Allred is saying, I'll be your lawyer.
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德说，我来做你们的律师。

sentences.en: Women are now empowered, and they will never be silent again.
sentences.zh: 女性现在被赋予了力量，她们再也不会保持沉默了。

sentences.en: And a number of them...
sentences.zh: 而她们中的一些人……

sentences.en: Thank you for coming today.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们今天能来。

sentences.en: ...say yes.
sentences.zh: ……说愿意。

sentences.en: Today I'm here with another woman who alleges that she was sexually harassed by Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 今天我和另一位女性一起来到这里，她声称自己曾受到哈维·温斯坦的性骚扰。

sentences.en: Gloria is amazing, and so amazing for someone like me who's not a celebrity, doesn't have the support system that they have, to have someone like Gloria...
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚太棒了，对于像我这样不是名人、没有她们那种支持系统的人来说，能有格洛丽亚这样的人支持，真是太棒了……

sentences.en: Today, a new accuser of Harvey Weinstein is speaking out about the sexual harassment that she alleges that she endured as a young actress and screenwriter.
sentences.zh: 今天，哈维·温斯坦的一位新指控者站出来，讲述了她声称自己在年轻时作为演员和编剧所遭受的性骚扰。

sentences.en: Who, at the request of Mr. Weinstein...
sentences.zh: 她应温斯坦先生的要求……

sentences.en: I felt so powerless.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常无助。

sentences.en: I didn't think anyone would believe me.
sentences.zh: 我以为没人会相信我。

sentences.en: I was nobody.
sentences.zh: 我当时是个无名小卒。

sentences.en: Why would they?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: And so, like, so many high-profile cases of this kind...
sentences.zh: 所以，像这类备受瞩目的案件……

sentences.en: There's Gloria Allred with her arms around these women...
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德（Gloria Allred）搂着这些女性……

sentences.en: ...insisting that she's going to help give them voice.
sentences.zh: ……坚称她要帮助她们发声。

sentences.en: But what she's not saying is that she and her firm had actually known that something was wrong for years and had actually helped keep it quiet.
sentences.zh: 但她没说的是，她和她的律所其实多年来一直知道有问题，甚至还帮忙掩盖真相。

sentences.en: Yesterday, in part one,
sentences.zh: 昨天，在第一部分中，

sentences.en: my colleagues Megan Tuohy and Jodi Kantor reported on how Lisa Bloom switched over to defend Harvey Weinstein and used her experience representing women to undermine them and to try to stop Megan and Jodi's investigation into Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 我的同事梅根·图伊（Megan Tuohy）和乔迪·坎托（Jodi Kantor）报道了丽莎·布鲁姆（Lisa Bloom）如何转而为哈维·韦恩斯坦（Harvey Weinstein）辩护，并利用她代理女性受害者的经验来诋毁她们，试图阻止梅根和乔迪对韦恩斯坦的调查。

sentences.en: Today, in part two, after their investigation publishes, the role of Lisa's mother, Gloria Allred.
sentences.zh: 今天，在第二部分，在她们的调查发表后，我们要谈谈丽莎的母亲格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德的角色。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, September 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月19日，星期四。

sentences.en: So the newsroom is suddenly also inundated by stories about Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 新闻编辑室突然也被关于哈维·韦恩斯坦的报道淹没了。

sentences.en: We're getting email after email, call after call.
sentences.zh: 我们不断收到电子邮件和电话。

sentences.en: Our voicemail boxes are full on our cell phones, on our other phones.
sentences.zh: 我们的手机和座机语音信箱都满了。

sentences.en: And messages are coming in through Facebook and Instagram to the paper's tip line.
sentences.zh: 报社的举报热线也通过Facebook和Instagram收到了大量信息。

sentences.en: We have to call in more colleagues to help.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不召集更多同事来帮忙。

sentences.en: It's kind of surreal for us because for so many months we've been trying to get women to talk, and now they're coming to us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们来说有点不真实，因为几个月来我们一直试图让女性开口，现在她们主动找上门来了。

sentences.en: And so we're trying to understand as many of these stories as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正试图尽可能多地了解这些故事。

sentences.en: We're checking them out.
sentences.zh: 我们正在核实它们。

sentences.en: We're starting to publish more articles.
sentences.zh: 我们开始发表更多的文章。

sentences.en: And a lot of these stories are very revealing.
sentences.zh: 其中许多故事都非常有揭露性。

sentences.en: But when it comes to Gloria Allred's role, one in particular stands out.
sentences.zh: 但说到格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德的角色，有一个故事特别引人注目。

sentences.en: It was actually a tip that came in via email from an email address, harveyrapist at gmail.com, titled, Another Person Who Was Paid Off by Harvey for Near Rape.
sentences.zh: 那其实是一封通过电子邮件发来的举报，发件地址是harveyrapist@gmail.com，标题是“另一个被哈维收买以掩盖性侵未遂的人”。

sentences.en: And the name that was provided was Ashley Mathau.
sentences.zh: 提供的名字是阿什利·马索（Ashley Mathau）。

sentences.en: Hi, Ashley.
sentences.zh: 你好，阿什利。

sentences.en: It's Megan.
sentences.zh: 我是梅根。

sentences.en: And I ultimately got Ashley on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我最终联系上了阿什利。

sentences.en: Hey, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm doing better.
sentences.zh: 我好多了。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 那就好。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, listen, there's a ton of...
sentences.zh: 听着，有很多……

sentences.en: And you called Ashley back to talk to her for this story.
sentences.zh: 你给阿什利回了电话，为了这篇报道采访她。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Anyway, I'm just so grateful to be able to reconnect with you.
sentences.zh: 总之，能再次联系上你，我真的非常感激。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: And she started to tell me the story about what had happened to her in 2004.
sentences.zh: 她开始向我讲述2004年发生在她身上的事。

sentences.en: Well, I was dancing in a movie called Dirty Dancing Havana Nights, and it was in Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 当时我在一部叫《辣身舞2：情迷哈瓦那》的电影里跳舞，是在波多黎各拍的。

sentences.en: And I met Harvey on set there.
sentences.zh: 我在片场遇到了哈维。

sentences.en: He came there to visit one day.
sentences.zh: 有一天他来探班。

sentences.en: She was working as a backup dancer in one of Weinstein's movies.
sentences.zh: 她当时在韦恩斯坦的一部电影里担任伴舞。

sentences.en: And he came up to me to talk about future projects and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 他走过来跟我谈论未来的项目之类的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I mean, it's going to sound familiar now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在听起来会很耳熟。

sentences.en: You know, basically badgered into a work meeting at a hotel room.
sentences.zh: 你知道，基本上就是被强迫去酒店房间开工作会议。

sentences.en: And he was there with his assistant at the time.
sentences.zh: 他当时和他的助理在一起。

sentences.en: She was like around my age, and I felt a little more comfortable because, you know, I thought she was going to be there the whole time.
sentences.zh: 她和我年纪差不多大，我感觉稍微舒服了一点，因为我以为她会一直待在那里。

sentences.en: You know, he wasn't going to do anything with someone else in the room.
sentences.zh: 你知道，房间里有别人在，他应该不会做什么。

sentences.en: And then she shut the door, and I went in the room by myself.
sentences.zh: 然后她关上了门，我独自一人进了房间。

sentences.en: And so you don't have to, you know, you don't have to spell out everything that happened once you guys were in the hotel room.
sentences.zh: 你不需要，你知道，你不需要详细说明你们在酒店房间里发生的一切。

sentences.en: I'm not going to have to.
sentences.zh: 我不需要说。

sentences.en: She says that what happened once the door was closed was terrifying.
sentences.zh: 她说门关上后发生的事情非常可怕。

sentences.en: She says that he basically kind of pushed her down on the bed and masturbated over her.
sentences.zh: 她说他基本上把她推倒在床上，并在她身上自慰。

sentences.en: So I was just really terrified.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时真的非常害怕。

sentences.en: I felt like trash.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己像垃圾一样。

sentences.en: And when you got back to California, you know, who did you tell about what had happened?
sentences.zh: 当你回到加州时，你告诉了谁发生了什么事？

sentences.en: I talked to Charlie, my fiancé, at the time.
sentences.zh: 我告诉了当时的未婚夫查理（Charlie）。

sentences.en: He was very upset, but he suggested to talk to Gloria Allred and to kind of stand up for myself.
sentences.zh: 他非常生气，但他建议我去找格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德，为自己挺身而出。

sentences.en: So he immediately thinks of Gloria.
sentences.zh: 所以他立刻想到了格洛丽亚。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: She's the first person that comes to mind.
sentences.zh: 她是第一个想到的人。

sentences.en: He has seen her on TV.
sentences.zh: 他在电视上见过她。

sentences.en: He has seen her by the sides of victims and, you know, recounting their stories through tears.
sentences.zh: 他见过她站在受害者身边，看着她们含泪讲述自己的故事。

sentences.en: And he really says, I think if anybody can help you, it's Gloria Allred.
sentences.zh: 他真的说，如果有人能帮你，那一定是格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德。

sentences.en: So what did you do?
sentences.zh: 那你做了什么？

sentences.en: What was your first interaction?
sentences.zh: 你们第一次接触是什么样的？

sentences.en: Did you pick up the phone and call Gloria or?
sentences.zh: 你是拿起电话打给格洛丽亚了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we talked to Gloria.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们和格洛丽亚谈过。

sentences.en: And Gloria, I think, was like busy at the time.
sentences.zh: 我想格洛丽亚当时很忙。

sentences.en: So she referred me to John West at her firm.
sentences.zh: 所以她把我转介给了她律所的约翰·韦斯特（John West）。

sentences.en: Who counseled Ashley that her best option was to accept a secret settlement.
sentences.zh: 他建议阿什利最好的选择是接受一份秘密和解协议。

sentences.en: They offered like a $125,000 settlement.
sentences.zh: 他们提出了一笔大约12.5万美元的和解金。

sentences.en: And John advised me just to take it.
sentences.zh: 约翰建议我直接接受。

sentences.en: You know, you're not really strong enough to kind of go up against him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你当时并没有足够强大的力量去对抗他。

sentences.en: And so that's what I ended up doing.
sentences.zh: 所以我最终还是接受了。

sentences.en: Meaning an agreement in which the victim will accept money and everybody will basically agree not to talk about it anymore.
sentences.zh: 这意味着一份协议，受害者接受金钱，而所有人基本上都同意不再谈论此事。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Were there any other sort of stipulations or clauses in the settlement that you recall?
sentences.zh: 你还记得和解协议中是否有其他任何条款或规定吗？

sentences.en: I remember them saying that they, you know, wanted me to talk about Harvey in like a good light and, you know, that I only just saw him on the set.
sentences.zh: 我记得他们说，你知道，他们希望我以正面的角度谈论哈维，并且说我只是在片场见过他。

sentences.en: He was a great person to work for.
sentences.zh: 他是个很棒的工作伙伴。

sentences.en: I couldn't say anything negative about him or the situation.
sentences.zh: 我不能对他或当时的情况说任何负面的话。

sentences.en: She is legally prohibited from ever talking about what happened ever again.
sentences.zh: 她在法律上被禁止再谈论曾经发生过的事情。

sentences.en: The restrictive clauses that go along with these settlements are remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这些和解协议中附带的限制性条款非常惊人。

sentences.en: You know, women oftentimes can't tell their husbands.
sentences.zh: 你知道，女性往往连自己的丈夫都不能告诉。

sentences.en: They can't tell their colleagues.
sentences.zh: 她们不能告诉同事。

sentences.en: If they want to see a therapist, the therapist has to sign a confidentiality clause.
sentences.zh: 如果她们想看心理医生，医生也必须签署保密协议。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: They have to turn over any evidence, any documentation they have of what's happened.
sentences.zh: 她们必须交出所有证据，以及她们所拥有的关于所发生之事的任何文件。

sentences.en: I wasn't happy about that, but I guess I felt like it was really my only option.
sentences.zh: 我对此并不高兴，但我想我觉得这确实是我唯一的选择。

sentences.en: And John told me it was really my only option.
sentences.zh: 约翰也告诉我，这确实是我唯一的选择。

sentences.en: So 13 years pass.
sentences.zh: 就这样，13年过去了。

sentences.en: Tell me what you're thinking when you see the news about Harvey Weinstein break in October 2017.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，当你看到2017年10月关于哈维·温斯坦的新闻爆发时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: I was just blown away and shot and kind of numb.
sentences.zh: 我当时完全震惊了，整个人都懵了，感觉有点麻木。

sentences.en: I was really surprised at the amount of women that he did that to.
sentences.zh: 我对被他伤害的女性数量之多感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: It put all the puzzles together.
sentences.zh: 这把所有的拼图都凑齐了。

sentences.en: And did you see in that first week, like within days of that story breaking,
sentences.zh: 在那第一周，也就是故事曝光后的几天内，你有没有看到……

sentences.en: did you see Gloria Allred going out in front of the TV cameras and saying that she would represent Weinstein victims?
sentences.zh: 你有没有看到格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德出现在电视摄像机前，说她愿意代理温斯坦的受害者？

sentences.en: Yes, which is funny because she didn't really have the time back in 2004.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很有趣，因为她在2004年的时候并没有时间。

sentences.en: But then all of a sudden, you know, once it was like a news story, then she was representing like 14 or something.
sentences.zh: 但突然之间，你知道，一旦这成了新闻，她就开始代理大约14个人之类的。

sentences.en: I'm not sure what the specific number was, but it was it was interesting that she was offering to represent victims,
sentences.zh: 我不确定具体数字是多少，但有趣的是，她主动提出要代理受害者，

sentences.en: victims, but not making any mention that she had been aware of you.
sentences.zh: 代理受害者，却只字未提她其实早就知道你的存在。

sentences.en: Yes, that really upset me.
sentences.zh: 是的，那真的让我很心烦。

sentences.en: So why is Ashley telling you this?
sentences.zh: 那么，阿什莉为什么要告诉你这些？

sentences.en: And even how is she able to tell you this?
sentences.zh: 甚至她是怎么能告诉你这些的？

sentences.en: Well, she's not legally able to tell me this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她在法律上是不能告诉我的。

sentences.en: She is technically breaking her settlement.
sentences.zh: 她实际上是在违反她的和解协议。

sentences.en: And this moment is she starting to tell me everything that's happened.
sentences.zh: 就在这一刻，她开始告诉我所发生的一切。

sentences.en: And she is deciding that she's willing to face the legal risks because she feels that strongly about telling the world about what happened to her.
sentences.zh: 她决定愿意承担法律风险，因为她觉得向世界讲述发生在她身上的事情非常重要。

sentences.en: So she tells me that she actually gets on the phone with Gloria Allred herself.
sentences.zh: 所以她告诉我，她实际上亲自给格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德打了电话。

sentences.en: You know, I called Gloria's office and I talked to John, letting him know that my therapist had said it would be kind of healing and good to come forward.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我给格洛丽亚的办公室打了电话，并和约翰谈了，让他知道我的心理医生说站出来会是一种治愈，也是件好事。

sentences.en: And he said that he couldn't talk to me about it, that I would have to talk to Gloria.
sentences.zh: 他说他不能和我谈这个，我必须和格洛丽亚谈。

sentences.en: And she got on the phone with me when she was in New York.
sentences.zh: 当她在纽约时，她接了我的电话。

sentences.en: It was like 9 p.m.
sentences.zh: 当时大约是晚上9点。

sentences.en: in New York time.
sentences.zh: 纽约时间。

sentences.en: And Gloria started the conversation with,
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚开场就说，

sentences.en: Do you realize how lucky you are to be on the phone with me while I'm in New York at 9 p.m.
sentences.zh: 你意识到你有多幸运吗？能在晚上9点我在纽约的时候，

sentences.en: from my hotel room?
sentences.zh: 从我的酒店房间里和你通电话？

sentences.en: I deal with a lot of, like, high-profile people.
sentences.zh: 我处理的都是很多高调人物的事情。

sentences.en: So I was just, like, blown away by that.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时简直被惊呆了。

sentences.en: So I explained to her the way I was feeling.
sentences.zh: 所以我向她解释了我的感受。

sentences.en: And I felt like now, knowing all the stuff that I knew, that I felt like it was the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 我觉得现在，了解了我知道的所有事情后，我觉得这是正确的做法。

sentences.en: And she advised me against it.
sentences.zh: 但她劝我不要这样做。

sentences.en: And I, you know, I asked her why.
sentences.zh: 我问她为什么。

sentences.en: And she said because of the NDA and that he could sue.
sentences.zh: 她说因为有保密协议，而且他可以起诉。

sentences.en: And I said, yeah, but I feel like back then I didn't know the things that I know now.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，但我感觉当时我并不知道我现在知道的这些事情。

sentences.en: And she goes, well, you're willing to take that risk?
sentences.zh: 她说，好吧，你愿意承担那个风险吗？

sentences.en: Like, are you and Charlie Mitch?
sentences.zh: 比如，你和查理·米奇（Charlie Mitch）怎么样？

sentences.en: Like, how much money do you have?
sentences.zh: 你有多少钱？

sentences.en: And I was like, uh, I don't, it was just a really, really weird conversation.
sentences.zh: 我说，呃，我没有，那真是一次非常、非常奇怪的谈话。

sentences.en: Megan, tell me if I have this correct.
sentences.zh: 梅根，告诉我我理解得对不对。

sentences.en: At the same time that Allred is telling Ashley not to come forward as a victim of Harvey Weinstein,
sentences.zh: 在奥尔雷德告诉阿什莉不要以哈维·温斯坦受害者的身份站出来的同时，

sentences.en: in the wake of your investigation, she is publicly representing women who have come forward since your investigation published with new accusations against Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 在你们的调查之后，她却在公开代理那些在你们调查发表后站出来指控温斯坦的新受害者。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And privately, she is counseling this other Weinstein accuser to stay quiet.
sentences.zh: 而在私下里，她却在劝说这位温斯坦的指控者保持沉默。

sentences.en: She is telling her, if we get phone calls, we won't even acknowledge that we represented you in this case.
sentences.zh: 她告诉她，如果我们接到电话，我们甚至不会承认我们曾代理过你的案子。

sentences.en: And the other thing that kind of hurt or upset me was the fact that they would say that they represented me.
sentences.zh: 另一件让我感到受伤或心烦的事情是，他们甚至不承认曾代理过我。

sentences.en: They wouldn't even acknowledge that.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不承认这一点。

sentences.en: But yet they have so many other clients after the fact, after it all broke out.
sentences.zh: 但在这件事爆发后，他们却代理了那么多其他的客户。

sentences.en: So that upset me.
sentences.zh: 这让我很心烦。

sentences.en: Did you think that she thought that she or her firm would lose money if you broke the settlement?
sentences.zh: 你认为她是否觉得如果你打破和解协议，她或她的律所会损失金钱？

sentences.en: I think I recall you saying that they had taken a 40% cut of the payment that was made to you.
sentences.zh: 我记得你说过，他们从支付给你的款项中抽成了40%。

sentences.en: Yeah, they took a 40% cut.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们抽成了40%。

sentences.en: I don't really know how that works.
sentences.zh: 我不太清楚那是怎么运作的。

sentences.en: Maybe she felt like she would lose money on it.
sentences.zh: 也许她觉得她会因此损失金钱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I don't really know what the reason was.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道原因是什么。

sentences.en: I thought it was either that or it was either something to do with her knowing about this whole Weinstein thing back in 2004
sentences.zh: 我以为要么是那样，要么是与她早在2004年就知道整个温斯坦事件有关，

sentences.en: and her being like the top women's rights activist and being known for that and having that reputation.
sentences.zh: 而且她作为顶尖的女权活动家，以那个身份闻名，拥有那样的声誉。

sentences.en: I thought that she would be behind me, especially since she knew a lot about the case and was representing people, other people.
sentences.zh: 我以为她会支持我，尤其是因为她很了解这个案子，而且还在代理其他人。

sentences.en: Did that change your perception of Gloria?
sentences.zh: 这改变了你对格洛丽亚的看法吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，绝对改变了。

sentences.en: I felt like she wanted basically all the media attention.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她基本上是想要所有的媒体关注。

sentences.en: Like once it became a big story, then she wanted to be a part of it.
sentences.zh: 一旦这变成了一个大新闻，她就想参与其中。

sentences.en: But when it was not in front of the cameras, it was something that she didn't.
sentences.zh: 但当不在摄像机前时，她却不想那样做。

sentences.en: So what are you thinking at this point?
sentences.zh: 那么你现在是怎么想的？

sentences.en: You know, it's complicated.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很复杂。

sentences.en: You know, on the one hand, I know that these secret settlements exist and that lawyers like Gloria Allred have been involved in them.
sentences.zh: 一方面，我知道这些秘密和解协议确实存在，而且像格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德这样的律师也参与其中。

sentences.en: And I recognize that victims should receive financial compensation for what's happened to them.
sentences.zh: 我承认受害者应该为她们所经历的事情获得经济赔偿。

sentences.en: But on the other hand,
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，

sentences.en: I'm also realizing more and more that by negotiating and participating in these types of secret settlements that Gloria Allred has basically helped Harvey Weinstein cover his tracks.
sentences.zh: 我也越来越意识到，通过协商和参与这类秘密和解协议，格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德基本上帮助哈维·温斯坦掩盖了他的行径。

sentences.en: These secret settlements basically erase any evidence of, in his case, a very long pattern of alleged predation.
sentences.zh: 这些秘密和解协议基本上抹去了任何证据，就他而言，抹去了长期以来被指控的掠夺行为模式。

sentences.en: And look, not all of these cases are Harvey Weinstein situations where you have a secret settlement followed by another allegation, followed by a secret settlement,
sentences.zh: 听着，并非所有这些案件都是哈维·温斯坦那种情况，即先有一个秘密和解，接着是另一次指控，再接着是另一个秘密和解，

sentences.en: followed by another allegation.
sentences.zh: 然后又是另一次指控。

sentences.en: But if we look in Gloria Allred's case file, we do see that she did help silence an alleged victim of Bill O'Reilly's and a victim of Larry Nassar's.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们查看格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德的案卷，我们确实看到她确实帮助让比尔·奥莱利（Bill O'Reilly）和拉里·纳萨尔（Larry Nassar）的一名受害者保持了沉默。

sentences.en: In addition to a victim of Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 除了哈维·温斯坦的一名受害者之外。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Looking at it now, knowing everything you know, what do you think about these types of secret settlements and their role in sexual harassment and sexual assault cases?
sentences.zh: 现在回顾起来，了解了你所知道的一切，你对这类秘密和解协议及其在性骚扰和性侵犯案件中的作用有什么看法？

sentences.en: Now, knowing what I know, I don't think they're right.
sentences.zh: 现在，了解了我知道的一切，我不认为它们是正确的。

sentences.en: I think it makes the assaulter able to do it to other people and hide it.
sentences.zh: 我认为这使得施暴者能够对其他人如法炮制并将其隐藏起来。

sentences.en: And the thing that you would think with, like, the lawyers would be that they would protect you and to, like, you just,
sentences.zh: 你会认为律师应该保护你，而你只是……

sentences.en: you don't feel comfortable to move forward and to go against these people, especially, like, someone like Harvey.
sentences.zh: 你觉得没有安全感去继续前进，去对抗这些人，尤其是像哈维这样的人。

sentences.en: So you feel like that's your only option.
sentences.zh: 所以你觉得那是你唯一的选择。

sentences.en: I mean, that's not the only thing that helped Harvey, but I don't think it's a good idea.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那不是唯一帮助哈维的事情，但我不认为这是个好主意。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much, Ashley.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你，阿什莉。

sentences.en: Truly.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间去深入了解付费墙背后的内容，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Megan, Jodi, the obvious question in all of this would be, why would Gloria Allred do this?
sentences.zh: 梅根，朱迪，这一切中显而易见的问题是，格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: This woman that we think of as an outspoken champion of women?
sentences.zh: 这个我们认为是女性直言不讳的捍卫者的女人？

sentences.en: Because this is actually pretty standard.
sentences.zh: 因为这实际上相当标准。

sentences.en: There are women signing these kinds of secret settlements every single day.
sentences.zh: 每天都有女性在签署这类秘密和解协议。

sentences.en: This is more or less the way we deal with sexual harassment in this country.
sentences.zh: 这或多或少是我们在这个国家处理性骚扰的方式。

sentences.en: Remember that the system for getting justice or redress in these cases is very, very complicated.
sentences.zh: 记住，在这些案件中寻求正义或赔偿的系统非常、非常复杂。

sentences.en: To bring a case to court can take years.
sentences.zh: 将案件诉诸法庭可能需要数年时间。

sentences.en: It can be expensive and draining.
sentences.zh: 它可能既昂贵又令人精疲力竭。

sentences.en: You can ruin your reputation.
sentences.zh: 你可能会毁了自己的名声。

sentences.en: You can be branded a traitor or a tattletale.
sentences.zh: 你可能会被贴上叛徒或告密者的标签。

sentences.en: Even if you win in court, the damages are capped at a couple of hundred thousand dollars.
sentences.zh: 即使你在法庭上胜诉，赔偿金也上限在几十万美元。

sentences.en: So there are lots of individual scenarios in which this really does look like the best available option.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多个人情况，这看起来确实是目前最好的选择。

sentences.en: I wonder if part of what she represents in doing this work, and other lawyers too, I wonder if they represent what women were willing to literally settle for, for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我想知道她做这项工作所代表的一部分，以及其他律师也是，我想知道她们是否代表了女性长期以来实际上愿意接受的底线。

sentences.en: That this was the best you could get.
sentences.zh: 这就是你能得到的最好的结果。

sentences.en: That if something bad happened to you, you could hopefully walk away with some money.
sentences.zh: 如果发生了不好的事情，你希望能带着一些钱离开。

sentences.en: You could walk away with your dignity intact.
sentences.zh: 你可以带着尊严离开。

sentences.en: Because for a long time, it really was presumed that this was something shameful.
sentences.zh: 因为在很长一段时间里，人们确实认为这是一件可耻的事情。

sentences.en: This was something you wouldn't want anyone to know.
sentences.zh: 这是一件你不想让任何人知道的事情。

sentences.en: And it's only been pretty recently that that idea has started to change.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，这种观念才开始改变。

sentences.en: You know, I have actually spoken to Gloria Allred about this issue more than once over the last couple years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在过去几年里，我实际上不止一次地与格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德谈过这个问题。

sentences.en: And she does, in fact, make a lot of the arguments that Jodi just spelled out on why these things serve her clients and why they'd want them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她确实提出了朱迪刚才列举的许多论点，说明为什么这些协议对她的客户有用，以及为什么她们会想要这些协议。

sentences.en: She also, in our last conversation, acknowledged that some of her clients actually don't want secrecy.
sentences.zh: 在我们的最后一次谈话中，她也承认，她的一些客户实际上并不想要保密。

sentences.en: She said that, you know, a client will say, I want to be compensated.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，客户会说，我想要得到赔偿。

sentences.en: This is a significant amount you've been able to achieve for me.
sentences.zh: 这是你为我争取到的可观金额。

sentences.en: I'm very happy with that.
sentences.zh: 我对这个结果很满意。

sentences.en: But why should I have to keep secret?
sentences.zh: 但我为什么要保密呢？

sentences.en: And she acknowledged that she herself has often talked the women into it, talked the clients into it, saying, that's because that powerful figure wants peace, wants to end it,
sentences.zh: 她承认她自己经常劝说女性接受，劝说客户接受，说那是因为那个有权势的人物想要和平，想要结束这一切，

sentences.en: and wants to move on in the same way that you want to move on.
sentences.zh: 并且想要像你一样继续生活下去。

sentences.en: And that's the essence of the problem.
sentences.zh: 而这正是问题的本质。

sentences.en: Are these secret settlements giving women some compensation for harm that they've experienced?
sentences.zh: 这些秘密和解协议是否为女性所遭受的伤害提供了一些补偿？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Are they solving the problem of sexual harassment in this country?
sentences.zh: 它们是否解决了这个国家的性骚扰问题？

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.en: Are they, in fact, allowing perpetrators to go on and harm other people?
sentences.zh: 事实上，它们是否在允许施暴者继续伤害其他人？

sentences.en: And it seems like, based on your reporting, we know that in some cases, they are.
sentences.zh: 根据你们的报道，看起来我们知道在某些情况下，确实如此。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I was surprised when you decided to represent Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 当你决定担任哈维·温斯坦的辩护律师时，我很惊讶。

sentences.en: Tell us why.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们原因。

sentences.en: Well, that is the question a lot of people are asking.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这正是许多人都在问的问题。

sentences.en: So catch us up on Gloria Allred and her daughter, Lisa Bloom.
sentences.zh: 那么，给我们讲讲格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德和她女儿丽莎·布鲁姆的近况吧。

sentences.en: When we left off with Lisa, she was facing tremendous blowback for her role in representing Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 我们上次提到丽莎时，她正因代理哈维·温斯坦一案而面临巨大的舆论反弹。

sentences.en: Yes, and almost immediately she changed messaging.
sentences.zh: 是的，她几乎立刻就改变了口径。

sentences.en: Okay, so first let me say, I very much regret ever being involved in this.
sentences.zh: 好的，首先我想说，我非常后悔参与其中。

sentences.en: I'm mortified that I was connected with him in any way.
sentences.zh: 我对自己曾以任何方式与他产生关联感到羞愧。

sentences.en: And all the people who have reached out to me to say, Lisa, you know, we're hurt, we're disappointed in you.
sentences.zh: 所有那些联系我并说“丽莎，你知道吗，我们很受伤，我们对你很失望”的人，

sentences.en: Like, I get it.
sentences.zh: 我都能理解。

sentences.en: And I'm very, very sorry.
sentences.zh: 对此我深表歉意。

sentences.en: She said that she had been unaware of all of the serious allegations against him, that she had only tried to help him see the error of his ways,
sentences.zh: 她说她之前并不了解针对他的所有严重指控，她只是试图帮助他认识到自己的错误，

sentences.en: but that it had been actually a grave error of judgment on her part, and that she was going to return to working with only women 100% of the time.
sentences.zh: 但实际上这是她判断上的严重失误，她将回归到百分之百只为女性提供法律服务的状态。

sentences.en: You know, one of the lessons for this in me is, I've talked to everybody in my law firm,
sentences.zh: 你知道，这件事给我的教训是，我已经和律所里的每个人谈过了，

sentences.en: we are no longer ever going to represent somebody accused of sexual harassment or sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 我们以后绝不会再代理任何被控性骚扰或性侵犯的人。

sentences.en: They're entitled to lawyers, but it's not going to be us.
sentences.zh: 他们有权聘请律师，但那个人不会是我们。

sentences.en: And since then, she's really, has in fact worked to rehabilitate her image.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，她确实在努力修复自己的形象。

sentences.en: She's represented women in a variety of high-profile cases, including...
sentences.zh: 她代理了各种备受瞩目的女性案件，包括……

sentences.en: Lisa Bloom is with me.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·布鲁姆现在和我在一起。

sentences.en: She is a victim's rights attorney.
sentences.zh: 她是一位受害者权益律师。

sentences.en: She is representing two of Epstein's accusers.
sentences.zh: 她正在代理两名爱泼斯坦的指控者。

sentences.en: Lisa, thank you so much for being with me.
sentences.zh: 丽莎，非常感谢你能来。

sentences.en: In the case of Jeffrey Epstein, she is now, at least last time we checked, representing two of Epstein's alleged victiMs.
sentences.zh: 在杰弗里·爱泼斯坦一案中，她现在——至少我们上次核实时是这样——正在代理两名爱泼斯坦的所谓受害者。

sentences.en: They were worked as young waitresses at a coffee shop.
sentences.zh: 她们曾在一家咖啡店做过年轻女服务员。

sentences.en: They were also...
sentences.zh: 她们还……

sentences.en: Megan, that is genuinely shocking.
sentences.zh: 梅根，这真是令人震惊。

sentences.en: Everything you have told us here paints a portrait of a woman who used her credibility as a defender of women to try to undermine them in defense of Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 你在这里告诉我们的一切，描绘了一个女人的形象：她利用自己作为女性捍卫者的信誉，试图在为哈维·温斯坦辩护时去诋毁那些受害者。

sentences.en: And now you're saying that she's getting new clients who want her to defend them against the Harvey Weinsteins of the world.
sentences.zh: 而现在你说她又接到了新的客户，他们想让她保护他们免受像哈维·温斯坦那样的人的侵害。

sentences.en: How does that work?
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能呢？

sentences.en: Well, nobody has known about all of those sort of secret records that spelled out exactly the type of work that she did for Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没人知道那些详细记录了她为温斯坦所做工作的秘密档案。

sentences.en: The memo in which she spelled out all of the different underhanded tactics that she was going to use to help him go after his accusers.
sentences.zh: 那份备忘录里详细列出了她打算用来帮助他攻击指控者的各种卑劣手段。

sentences.en: All of the explicit work that she did to help him evade scrutiny and cover up women's allegations.
sentences.zh: 还有她为帮助他逃避审查和掩盖女性指控所做的所有明确工作。

sentences.en: We are just coming forward with that information now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在才刚刚披露这些信息。

sentences.en: So in reality, we don't know what's going to happen here when it comes to Lisa Bloom and her representations.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，我们不知道丽莎·布鲁姆及其代理工作接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: No, this is just starting to play out.
sentences.zh: 没错，这一切才刚刚开始上演。

sentences.en: And what about Gloria?
sentences.zh: 那格洛丽亚呢？

sentences.en: Gloria Allred has continued to play basically the same role on the public stage that she has for a long time.
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德在公共舞台上继续扮演着她长期以来扮演的角色。

sentences.en: She's viewed as a fierce champion for women.
sentences.zh: 她被视为女性的坚定捍卫者。

sentences.en: It is an honor and a privilege to present this award for her commitment to empowering women.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸能颁发这个奖项，以表彰她为赋权女性所做的贡献。

sentences.en: She gets honors all the time.
sentences.zh: 她总是获得各种荣誉。

sentences.en: Gloria, we all thank you from the bottom of our hearts.
sentences.zh: 格洛丽亚，我们都从心底里感谢你。

sentences.en: There was just a Netflix documentary that was made about her that was very laudatory.
sentences.zh: 最近刚出了一部关于她的Netflix纪录片，评价非常高。

sentences.en: This has got to end and it needs to end right now.
sentences.zh: 这一切必须结束，而且必须现在就结束。

sentences.en: There is a war on women.
sentences.zh: 这是一场针对女性的战争。

sentences.en: Women depend on me to be strong.
sentences.zh: 女性依赖我变得坚强。

sentences.en: And in fact, as we head into the Harvey Weinstein trial, which is supposed to start in January.
sentences.zh: 事实上，随着我们进入预计于一月开始的哈维·温斯坦审判，

sentences.en: Actress Natasya Malte joins me now along with her attorney, Gloria Allred, who is representing several women accusing Weinstein of sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 女演员娜塔莎·马尔特现在和我在一起，还有她的律师格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德，她正在代理几名指控温斯坦性不当行为的女性。

sentences.en: She's actually going to be the lawyer for two of the alleged victiMs.
sentences.zh: 她实际上将担任其中两名所谓受害者的律师。

sentences.en: We did ask both women to come on the show for interviews.
sentences.zh: 我们确实邀请了这两位女性来节目接受采访。

sentences.en: And Gloria Allred said that she was not available to do that within our time frame.
sentences.zh: 但格洛丽亚·奥尔雷德说她在我们的时间安排内无法接受采访。

sentences.en: And Lisa Bloom sent us an email.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·布鲁姆给我们发了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: And this is what she wrote back.
sentences.zh: 这是她回复的内容。

sentences.en: Jodi and Megan, congratulations on the book.
sentences.zh: 乔迪和梅根，祝贺你们的新书出版。

sentences.en: I appreciate your reaching out, but due to my heavy litigation caseload, I'm not available for this interview.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们的联络，但由于我手头的诉讼案件繁多，无法接受这次采访。

sentences.en: Best wishes on the daily.
sentences.zh: 祝《每日》节目一切顺利。

sentences.en: I enjoy the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这个播客。

sentences.en: Best, Lisa Bloom.
sentences.zh: 最好的祝愿，丽莎·布鲁姆。

sentences.en: Much of the information in this episode was reported by Megan and Jodi for their new book, She Said.
sentences.zh: 本期节目中的大部分信息由梅根和乔迪为她们的新书《她说》所报道。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to another day.
sentences.zh: 以下是今天你需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: In Israel, the full results of national elections left Benny Gantz and his politically moderate party with slightly greater support in the Israeli parliament
sentences.zh: 在以色列，全国大选的最终结果显示，本尼·甘茨及其政治温和派政党在以色列议会中获得的支持率略高于

sentences.en: than Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his conservative party.
sentences.zh: 总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡及其保守党。

sentences.en: But neither man with enough support to form a majority coalition on their own.
sentences.zh: 但两人都没有获得足够的支持来单独组建多数派联盟。

sentences.en: The Times reports that a large turnout by liberal and Arab voters deprived Netanyahu of a majority in what amounted to a turning point in Israeli politics
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，自由派和阿拉伯选民的高投票率使内塔尼亚胡失去了多数席位，这构成了以色列政治的一个转折点，

sentences.en: and a rejection of Netanyahu's hard-right approach.
sentences.zh: 也是对内塔尼亚胡极右翼路线的否定。

sentences.en: Now, Gantz and Netanyahu are both jockeying to court enough smaller parties to build a viable majority and claim the prime minister's office.
sentences.zh: 现在，甘茨和内塔尼亚胡都在争相拉拢足够多的小党派，以建立一个可行的多数派并争取总理职位。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日》的内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在任何收听播客的地方订阅收听。
